patch_description: Add a D6-symmetric seed (two staggered hexagonal rings + 2 poles) as a structured initial basin, plus a few random starts. Then optimize with a soft-min/soft-max annealed objective on the free (unconstrained) configuration, which directly targets the dmin/dmax ratio rather than only dmin on a sphere. Prior generations converged near the D6 structure (ratio ~0.22, squared ratio ~1/4.165 ≈ 0.24); seeding directly inside that basin lets the local optimizer refine to the symmetric optimum. Add a final exact-ratio polish step.
